why: Issue #920. Puts the claim back exactly as it stood. `aria-modal="true"` tells assistive technology that everything outside the element is unavailable, and `applyModalIsolation` is what makes that true -- it runs for an overlay LAYER, and the splash is a `setState` surface, so it was never reached. This is the restored defect, not a hypothetical one, and it is silent: the attribute reads correct to anyone inspecting the markup.
killedBy: HUD landmarks (issue #629) claims aria-modal only on the two overlays that are really isolated
